title: Unbiased Open World Regularization for Fair Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2607.22149v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite recent advances, self-supervised learning (SSL) models and Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) remain susceptible to spurious correlations. Many anti-collapse regularizers constrain the global representation distribution to match a prescribed target, such as a multivariate Gaussian or the uniform distribution on the sphere. However, global matching does not prevent groups defined by a bias attribute from occupying distinct regions of the representation space. We show that existing encoder-only debiasing regularizers, including EnD and FSCL, can be interpreted as restricted forms of conditional distribution matching. Building on this interpretation, we introduce Unbiased Open World (UOW), which matches the representation distribution within each observed bias group to a common target distribution. translated_title: 面向公平自监督学习的无偏开放世界正则化
translated_abstract: 尽管近年来取得了诸多进展，自监督学习（SSL）模型和联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）仍然容易受到虚假相关性的影响。许多防塌缩正则化器将全局表示分布约束为匹配一个预设的目标分布，例如多元高斯分布或球面上的均匀分布。然而，这种全局匹配并不能阻止由某个偏差属性定义的群体在表示空间中占据不同的区域。我们证明了现有的仅编码器去偏正则化器（包括 EnD 和 FSCL）都可以被解释为条件分布匹配的受限形式。基于这一解释，我们提出了无偏开放世界，它将每个已观测偏差组内的表示分布匹配到一个共同的目标分布。在总体最优解处，使用判别式条件差异度量可以保证表示与偏差属性之间的独立性（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出无偏开放世界（UOW）正则化方法，通过将每个偏差组内的表示分布匹配到共同目标分布来保证表示与偏差属性的独立性，从而为自监督学习实现更有效的去偏与公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Unbiased Open World (UOW) regularization, which matches the representation distribution within each observed bias group to a common target distribution, guaranteeing independence between representations and bias attributes for fair self-supervised learning.
